title: Mesa Brothers vs. Radioactive Crocks
summary: On a vast mesa, two brothers, clad in simple skirts, gather for gaming. They practice archery, arrows made from calfskin, listening to the unbreakable speaker of an intercom. A crystal pickaxe, a raffle prize, rests nearby. Suddenly, a snowstorm hits. Their kayak is useless. An undertaker's bomb is vectored towards them by a promotional trucker. They retry, knowing an ulterior motive implemented these acts. The internet goes down. Their juices run cold as a griffin screams. The killing began. Kindness won, but nearly, for radioactive crocks threatened to eliminate them. The goldsmith, a freelancer, helped them respond. With bravery, they fought. Now, their history is written. A jumper, Jacky, jumped to their aid. The armory is filled. They exclude the warlock's wishing. No more wailing. A rhino's grave is a reminder. This latest novelty, a viking's hockeys, is a testament to their realization.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: On the sun-drenched mesa, two brothers converge for archery practice, listening to a gaming intercom speaker.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a sun-drenched, rugged mesa. Two brothers, one a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, the other younger, practice archery, their calfskin quivers full. They listen intently to a distant speaker from a gaming intercom, a promotional raffle ticket half-buried in the crystal-clear sand near a kayak. The light is warm golden hour, vibrant high-contrast concept art.

scenes.sentence: Through snow-covered kitschy terrain, the teenager's ulterior motive drives him as a griffin vectors near.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, scrambling through a kitschy, snow-covered landscape. A griffin, its feathers ruffled, lands nearby, having vectored its approach. He tries to unkink a frozen rope, his expression showing an ulterior motive, realizing his outfit isn't enough for the cold. The light is cool and desaturated, emphasizing the harsh conditions, vibrant high-contrast concept art.

scenes.sentence: Bathed in radioactive glow, the teenager's blurry face shows the irony of his jobbing, pickaxe ready.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up on the face of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, illuminated by the harsh rim lighting of a radioactive glow. His expression is blurry with intensity, nearly showing the irony of his jobbing for freelancers. He clutches a pickaxe, ready to eliminate the threat, a testament to his bravery in the face of a violated landscape. The light is harsh rim lighting, emphasizing the tension peak, vibrant high-contrast concept art.

scenes.sentence: From above, the transformed landscape reveals a poppy near a grave, a realization of new history.
scenes.prompt: Overhead shot of a transformed landscape, the grave of a defeated rhino now marked by a single poppy. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen from above, standing near a newly established armory. The upsurge of new life is visible, a realization that old histories can lead to novelty. The light is soft and diffused, a sense of resolution and consequence, vibrant high-contrast concept art.
